title: About
content: Whitaker Freight Services is a Knoxville-based freight brokerage and logistics consultancy founded in 2008. This blog shares how we vet carriers and keep freight moving.

title: Contact
content: Reach the team at info@whitakerfreight.com or call the office. We answer the phone, every time.

title: Privacy Policy
content: How we handle your information on this site. Short version: we collect only what we need to serve you.

title: Our Team
content: Meet the people behind Whitaker Freight Services, from dispatch to the front office.

title: Services
content: Truckload, reefer, flatbed, and cross-border brokerage across the Southeast and Midwest. Automotive parts, agricultural products, and building materials are our bread and butter.

title: Carrier Setup
content: Ready to haul for WFS? Send your operating authority, W-9, and certificate of insurance and we will get you set up. We answer the phone, every time.

title: Request a Quote
content: Tell us your lane, commodity, and pickup window and we will get you a rate. Most quotes back same day.

title: Cross-Border Freight
content: We move freight to and from Mexico and Canada with vetted cross-border carriers. Laredo and Detroit-Windsor crossings are routine for us.

title: DOT Compliance Webinars
content: Join our quarterly DOT compliance webinars. We cover FMCSA rules, audits, and what keeps your authority clean. Next session details posted soon.

title: TN Freight Mentorship Program
content: Our autumn cohort, run with Keith Burgess of Burgess Logistics, pairs new brokers with seasoned ones. Applications open for the next cohort.

title: Careers
content: WFS is a six-person shop with room to grow. We hire dispatchers and associates who answer the phone and treat carriers right.

title: Testimonials
content: What our clients say. From Cumberland Auto Parts to Valley Grain Cooperative, shippers count on WFS to keep freight moving.

title: Carrier Resources
content: Checklists, packets, and guides for the carriers who haul for us. Download the carrier setup packet and insurance requirements here.

title: Insurance Requirements
content: Minimum coverage to haul for WFS: auto liability, cargo, and a current certificate naming Whitaker Freight Services as certificate holder.

title: Whitaker Smoke Shop
content: Rubs, sauces, and BBQ gear Floyd swears by. A little side project from the brick smoker pit out back.

title: BBQ Recipes
content: Floyd's brisket, ribs, and pulled pork recipes, plus Mama June's chicken and dumplings. Low and slow is the only way.

title: Fishing Reports
content: Douglas Lake and Cherokee Lake reports, plus fly fishing notes from the Smokies. Updated when the bite is on.

title: Appalachian Railroad History
content: Maps and stories from the Great Valley and Cumberland Gap railroads. A passion of Floyd's going back to Harlan.

title: Faith and Community
content: WFS supports Ridgeview Baptist Church outreach and East Tennessee community events. Faith and freight both run on showing up.

title: Lane Rate Index
content: A running index of the lanes we run most, from Laredo to Knoxville and the Midwest grain corridors. Updated monthly.
